title: [nightly/speed] Read the analytics page's rounds once when nothing narrows them
summary: The analytics page and The Lab load their rounds from the database once instead of twice when no course or timeframe filter is set (the default), and run the two reads in parallel when a filter is set. Each read is 6–8 sequential round trips plus building every round.
